title: SQLite shadow database decision
summary: Documented SQLite as an optional rebuildable observability mirror rather than a second authority.
reason: Resolve storage ambiguity without creating new product features or deleting existing operator data.
behavior_before: SQLite shadow behavior existed but its durable integration direction was not recorded in the architecture decision log.
behavior_after: Architecture records retained bounded observability use, authoritative JSON/manifests/journals, safe ignore behavior, and separately gated rebuild/migration follow-up.
manual_validation: Reviewed StateDb writes, maintenance behavior, runtime artifact inventory, and focused storage observability test selection.
rollback_plan: Revert PI-001 documentation only; no database schema, writer, reader, or operator database file changed.
